title: nan
authors: Moron P.T.; Queralta J.P.; Westerlund T.
key_contribution: Presents a dynamic UWB role allocation approach for large-scale relative localization in multi-robot systems with application to GNSS-denied environments, including drone navigation demonstration.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
